one_line: New export controls disrupt shipments and investments, while security breaches, workforce restructurings, and new model rollouts shape global AI developments.

themes.title: Export controls disrupt global supply chains
themes.text: Nvidia halted AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries following new U.S. export controls, while the Dutch government moved to block a U.S. bill restricting ASML sales in China. Meanwhile, Z.ai missed its flagship model release due to U.S. computing restrictions and anti-distillation rules.

stories.headline: Nvidia stops shipping AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
Z.ai misses GLM-5.5 launch as US rules and distillation curbs hit China AI

themes.title: Security vulnerabilities and state hacking threats
themes.text: State-backed hackers from China and North Korea integrated the AI penetration tool Artex into their workflows. Additionally, confidential data sent to Chinese startup MiniMax was accessed by unauthorized parties, and Apple removed MiniMax's Talkie app from the App Store over safety concerns.

stories.headline: China and North Korean state-backed hackers add AI tool Artex to their arsenals
Confidential data sent to Chinese AI startup MiniMax accessed by unknown parties
Apple removes MiniMax chatbot Talkie from App Store worldwide

themes.title: Corporate restructuring and platform updates
themes.text: SAP plans to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to restructure its business for the artificial intelligence era. Google mandated that AI agents use Model Context Protocol servers starting in February 2027, and OpenAI rolled out updates including a merged ChatGPT interface and a fix for a launch-day billing error.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
Google mandates MCP server access for Workspace AI agents by February 2027
OpenAI begins rolling out merged ChatGPT Chat and Work tabs with shared usage meter
OpenAI fixes billing error, usage limits hit 40% faster on Astra, 25% faster on Sol

themes.title: India advances AI regulations and local models
themes.text: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology announced that upcoming AI regulation papers are in their final stages. The IndiaAI Mission also saw the launch of the Chariot-1 and Patram 1.5 model suites, alongside government clearance for Sarvam AI following scrutiny over hosted Chinese models.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission
Government finds no misuse of IndiaAI support in Sarvam Chinese model row
BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
